full_page.content:
1933, January
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 47 Cont.
Jan 9 SLEEPLESSNESS. Mrs. Anna Resco - 67 - 3617 Benson Ave. had not really slept for more than year, doctors and friends baffeled, comes and enrolles Dec. 12th 1927 when Epected in hospital for operation on leg. Went home and never went back to hospital, has been sleeping, and in perfect condition ever since now over five years. Deo Gr. .... Now comes to enroll again as against probable cancer forming on breast - received from fall week before last "All-halloween.
April 18 Pneumonia & Mrs Josephine Cosgain 37 (of Monteray at present Calif) Detroit - enrolled last Thursday at 4:40 p.m. hopelessly sick with pneumonia Empyaema and in a coma got well immediately went out for a ride on Saturday
END OF NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
